description: This Java class defines a strategy for handling PolicyEntryCreated events within the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends an abstract event strategy class and overrides a method to apply policy changes based on the event.

classes.name: PolicyEntryCreatedStrategy
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractPolicyEventStrategy that handles PolicyEntryCreated events by updating a PolicyBuilder instance.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the method to process a PolicyEntryCreated event and update the provided PolicyBuilder with the event's policy entry.
